meta.name: arboreto
meta.description: Infer gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from gene expression data using scalable algorithms (GRNBoost2, GENIE3). Use when analyzing transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq) to identify transcription factor-target gene relationships and regulatory interactions. Supports distributed computation for large-scale datasets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 识别转录因子与靶基因的调控关系
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有转录组数据,想找到基因间的调控网络
copy.tagline_en: Identify regulatory relationships between transcription factors and target genes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have transcriptomics data and want to uncover gene regulatory networks

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 arboreto 的 GRNBoost2 或 GENIE3 算法，从基因表达数据推断转录因子与靶基因的调控关系，产出含 TF、target、importance 三列的表格文件，并可在本地多核或集群上分布式运行。
howto.when: 当你分析 bulk RNA-seq、单细胞 RNA-seq 等转录组数据，要找出转录因子与靶基因的调控关系时触发；数据量大时可用分布式计算。

howto.what_en: Claude uses arboreto's GRNBoost2 or GENIE3 to infer gene regulatory networks from expression data, returning a table of TF, target, and importance scores, and can scale runs across local cores or a cluster.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you analyze transcriptomics data such as bulk RNA-seq or single-cell RNA-seq to find transcription factor-target relationships, including distributed runs for large datasets.
